page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: difficulter detinebantur milites fœderati; sed du-
cum authoritate, & pacis certo nuncio asperio-
ra illa consilia & conatus impediebantur. In omni-
bus illis motibus nihil humani sanguinis effundeba-
tur, præterquam in hoc ad Deæ pontem conflictu,
ubi duo fœderati desiderati sunt, sed ex altera pa-
rte plus minus quinquaginta, & complures vulnera-
tiinter quos Ionstonus quidam tribunus, vir acris & expediti ingenii.
Motibus sic compositis, ac arcibus regiis cum in-
tercepto apparatu bellico qui adhuc supererat, re-
gi traditis, & Scotorum exercitu dimisso; magnus
eos incessit metus, nam cohortes regiæ in limiti-
bus hærebant, & magno præsidiariorum numero
instruebantur Berwicum & Carleolum, urbes quidem
ditionis Angliæ, sed in ipsis Scotiæ limitibus sitæ; I-
ndictio synodi procrastinabatur; arcis Edinburgenæ
custodia perito belli duci committebatur, ac
multo commeatu & apparatu muniebatur, Rex
etiam serenissim: Berwici adhuc hærebat; & eo evo-
caverat decem & quatuor primarios confœderato-
rum, ut cum iis de rebus maximi momenti age-
ret; ac licet qui in vicinia hærebant, Nobiles
fœderati statim advolarent, & sociorum suorum ab-
sentiam excusarent, renuisse tamen regem (refere-
batur) cum illis agere, sed omnium exspectare
adventum, ac tum de sua voluntate prolixius omnes
simul intellecturos esse: Magnarum suspicionum
ansam hæc & plura hujus generis fœderatis præbe-
bant, & gravius aliquid subesse multorum fuit opi-
nio: etenim cum pauciores numero, & minoris
dignitatis totum pacificationis negotium antea ab-
solvissent, quorsum jam multo plures evocarentur,
præsertim selecta fœderatorum capita? & veteres
historias in mentem revocabant; neque novum esse
differebant, in minimis fidem præstruere ut postea
cum

page.notes: Catchword "cum" is at the foot, right, and is not repeated in the text. Hyphenated line-end words are joined with their printed hyphen: "vulnera-ti" as "vulneratiinter" is printed with no space after "ti," so I have kept "vulneratiinter" as one word, with the comma after it in print: check against the scan. "Ionstonus" and "Edinburgenæ" are read from print; "Ionstonus" may be a rendering of Johnstonus, and is copied as printed. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout. "Berwicum & Carleolum", "Angliæ", "Berwici" and "Edinburgenæ" are set in italic. The "Motibus" paragraph starts on an indented line.
